findings: Complete current MDX SHA-256 is ec8e40da0a926f441303f13dda68d1083e82e8857b8a8779ab05e63a4b7b609d; all 6 declared sources passed current access review.

Claims remain bounded to the EPA correction-request fields and NARA source/input/output distinction as explicitly nonbinding federal administrative analogies, plus current MRX validation, valuation-process, and package-index boundaries. No source is converted into a private correction right, source validation, title, acreage, decimal, value, fairness, appraisal, contract, or transaction conclusion.

The article invents no real owner, request, input, source record, property, buyer, contract, transaction, price, valuation result, testimonial, success rate, or owner-specific legal, tax, accounting, title, appraisal, investment, or transaction conclusion.

sources_inspected.label: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, EPA Information Quality Guidelines (accessed 2026-08-22)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The current EPA page identifies its Information Quality Guidelines and the federal correction-request mechanism for information disseminated by EPA.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article identifies the EPA process as a federal administrative analogy only. It does not claim that the process governs a private mineral-rights valuation, validates a replacement value, or creates a right to a revised result.

sources_inspected.label: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, Guidelines for Ensuring and Maximizing Information Quality, Section 8.2 (accessed 2026-08-22)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: Section 8.2 of the EPA guideline PDF describes correction requests that identify the requester, cite the disputed information, explain the concern, recommend corrective action, and describe the requester’s interest.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article borrows only that field-level request discipline. It omits agency-specific legal standards and makes no private right, validation, value, or correction conclusion.

sources_inspected.label: U.S. National Archives, Records Basics (accessed 2026-08-22)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The NARA Records Basics page distinguishes source records, input records, system content, and outputs in federal records-management guidance.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses that distinction only as a transparent administrative analogy for preserving the reviewed snapshot, source, input, and later output separately. It does not impose a private retention rule.

sources_inspected.label: Mineral Rights Xchange, How to Validate a Mineral Rights Valuation (accessed 2026-08-22)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The current MRX valuation-validation guide owns evidence review, transformation tracing, method and assumption review, reperformance, and result-difference analysis.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The correction-packet article begins only after a specific discrepancy has already been identified. It does not validate evidence, reperform a valuation, run sensitivities, or decide whether a requested replacement is correct.

sources_inspected.label: Mineral Rights Xchange, Understanding Texas Mineral Rights Valuation Process (accessed 2026-08-22)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The current MRX Texas valuation-process guide owns the traceable relationship among the analyzed interest, evidence, inputs, assumptions, range, and unresolved questions.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses that guide only to define the adjacent traceability job. It does not explain valuation methods, calculate value, revise a range, appraise an interest, or decide offer fairness.

sources_inspected.label: Mineral Rights Xchange, How to Build a Mineral Rights Sale Document Package Index (accessed 2026-08-22)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The current MRX document-package guide owns received-file identity, page and exhibit completeness, versions, and controlled component references.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The correction packet links to a stable component and page rather than rebuilding the package. It does not determine authenticity, completeness, title, legal effect, acreage, decimal interest, or document sufficiency.
